Origin: antmicro/gerber2ems, https://github.com/antmicro/gerber2ems, commit
3d5345508e8914fe16f059c5c8e9afbcbde53efd, directories examples/stub_short and
examples/stub_long: fabrication files of slices of the Antmicro Signal Integrity Test
Board and their one-port VNA measurements (vna.csv: S11 and Z at port SP1, port SP2
loaded, 0.2 to 6 GHz).

Added here: fab/board-stackup.yaml, a stackup of the four copper layers. Its top
(mask, 35 um copper, 0.12 mm of FR-4 with relative permittivity 4.18 and loss tangent
0.02, the first inner layer) is that of fab/stackup.json; the layers below the first inner
plane are assumed. No other file was changed.
